$comment: Diagnostic probes dari The Mom Test. Migrasi Fase 2 dari docs/knowledge/the-mom-test/mapping-novalianers.md §2. signal_interpretation = kerja intelektual baru (tidak ada di markdown) — makna jawaban user terhadap constraint target.

signal_interpretation.positive: Masalah muncul minggu/bulan ini — pain aktif, demand hypothesis naik
signal_interpretation.negative: Sudah lama tidak terjadi / hampir tidak pernah — pain teoretis, turunkan pain severity
signal_interpretation.neutral: Frekuensi sedang — perlu probe frekuensi lanjutan

probes.text: Tell me what you did back then — teach me step-by-step how you handled it.

signal_interpretation.positive: Concrete workflow explicitly stated: tools, costs, time, people involved — high-quality evidence for measuring severity
signal_interpretation.negative: Can't explain the details / the story is vague — a sign of not being directly involved in the problem

probes.text: What are the consequences if this problem is not resolved?

signal_interpretation.positive: Ada implikasi mahal terukur (uang/waktu/opportunitas hilang) — will-pay problem, pain severity naik + pricing anchor
signal_interpretation.negative: 'Ah, never mind' — annoying but tolerable problem; likely a vitamin, not a painkiller, downgrade severity

signal_interpretation.positive: Ada workaround aktif yang berbiaya (alat/staf/waktu) — price anchor + bukti masalah nyata; nilai anchor jadi reference pricing
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak melakukan apa-apa — tidak ada budget mengalir ke masalah ini; willingness-to-pay meragukan

probes.text: What else have you tried to resolve it?

signal_interpretation.positive: Sudah mencoba solusi lain dan kecewa — actively searching, demand hypothesis naik signifikan
signal_interpretation.negative: Belum pernah mencari solusi sama sekali — 'if they haven't looked, they won't buy yours'; bukan customer

signal_interpretation.positive: The real motivation is revealed and differs from the surface request — value framing must follow this motivation, not the feature requested
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak ada motivasi kuat — permintaan fitur tanpa alasan = tidak boleh diobey

probes.text: Where does the money come from? Who holds the purchasing decision?

signal_interpretation.positive: Kontak = budget owner / punya akses langsung ke decision maker — authority match
signal_interpretation.negative: Kontak bukan pemegang budget dan tidak bisa mengantar ke decision maker — authority mismatch; deal kemungkinan mati
signal_interpretation.neutral: Ada proses persetujuan berlapis — identifikasi semua veto holder sebelum lanjut

probes.text: How serious are you about this [area/business]?

signal_interpretation.positive: Menghasilkan uang / menghabiskan waktu-biaya signifikan / aspirasi bisnis nyata — painkiller customer
signal_interpretation.negative: Hobi, tidak ada investasi waktu/uang — vitamin; turunkan prioritas segmen ini

probes.text: What 3 big things are you currently trying to improve?

signal_interpretation.positive: Area masalah kita masuk top-3 prioritas mereka — must-solve, boleh zoom in
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak masuk daftar — premature zoom jika lanjut; kembali broad atau klasifikasikan non-customer

probes.text: Apa tujuan dan fokus besar Anda saat ini?

signal_interpretation.positive: Our problem comes up on its own without prompting — strong signal, safe to zoom
signal_interpretation.negative: Masalah kita tidak muncul saat pertanyaan terbuka — hati-hati: kemungkinan bukan masalah mereka

probes.text: How much time and money do you spend on this problem per week/month?

signal_interpretation.positive: Angka spesifik dan material — seriousness signal kuat + budget anchor
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu / mendekati nol — masalah tidak diinvestasi; turunkan demand confidence

probes.text: May I ask for [an intro to the decision maker / a case study / a pre-order / a deposit]?

signal_interpretation.positive: Commitment given (significant time/reputation/money) — the only valid proof; increase confidence in demand & proof
signal_interpretation.negative: Refusing or dodging with a vague promise ('later when it's done') — stalling; value = zero
signal_interpretation.neutral: Menawarkan komitmen generik — konkretkan dulu (siapa, kapan, kenapa tidak sekarang)

probes.text: Who else should I talk to about this?

signal_interpretation.positive: Give a specific intro with enthusiasm — the issues they care about; snowball distribution works
signal_interpretation.negative: Menolak intro — kemungkinan kita salah jalani percakapan (terlalu pitchy/formal) ATAU mereka tidak peduli; ambil dengan garam ekstra

probes.text: If [solution] were available now, when would you want to start?

signal_interpretation.positive: 'Now — this is my card' / ask for a trial with skin in the game — complainer vs customer strictly separated
signal_interpretation.negative: 'Next time' / 'once it's released' — complainer, not a customer; don't count it as pipeline

probes.text: Dari mana Anda biasanya tahu soal [topik/produk di area ini]?

signal_interpretation.positive: Concrete channels revealed (e.g., newspaper PR, specific recommendations) — distribution path for this segment identified
signal_interpretation.negative: There is no channel they trust — distribution to this segment will be expensive/difficult; a factor that goes into segment selection

probes.text: Is there anything I should have asked but didn't?

signal_interpretation.positive: User corrected the diagnostic path with a blind spot we missed — new question for list of 3
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak ada koreksi — jalur diagnosa tampak lengkap
